about_the_game:
In EVERGROW: SHARDS OF TOMORROW, the environment is the main character. Uncover the secrets of the lost world as you solve puzzles and unearth long lost murals. Take flight in your Starplane to escape the threats of this forsaken land. What will you discover? Can you restore what was lost?

Key Features

  • Discover a Unique World: Explore a desolate wasteland in search of a mysterious signal. Uncover relics of the past that reveal the story of a lost civilization.

  • Embark on an Adventure: What starts as a simple mission soon unravels into something far greater. In this linear, story-driven adventure, solve puzzles to progress and uncover the truth behind the planet’s downfall.

  • A Living Environment: As you uncover the past, witness the world change before your eyes. Clear the corruption and restore Evergrow to its former glory.

  • Take Flight: Navigate treacherous terrain with your trusty Starplane. But beware—danger lurks in the shadows. Are you truly alone?

  • Master the Gravity Beam: Use your Gravity Beam to manipulate objects, remove obstacles, and operate long-forgotten machinery to forge a path forward.

About the Game

EVERGROW is a puzzle-adventure game set in a ruined world, where players solve both physical and narrative-driven puzzles to uncover its forgotten past. Inspired by genre-defining classics, it features a retro aesthetic influenced by the timeless charm of older titles.

The game's main goal is to provide a visually stunning, atmospheric experience while evoking the feeling that no matter how much is broken, nothing is ever truly lost.

The game's core loop revolves around exploration, solving puzzles, and escaping threats, creating a cycle of discovery, challenge, and survival.

  • OS: Windows 10 (or newer)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3800X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1080
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Basic

Recommended:

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

short_description: Explore the ruined world of Evergrow, where echoes of a lost civilization whisper through the remnants of a once-thriving planet. Solve puzzles to piece together the truth of what led to its downfall. Can you restore what was lost, or will the shards of tomorrow shape its fate forever?
